messages:
nora: Quick follow-up on inc-492 postmortem draft: https://redwood.docs/inc-492. Need to lock down who does what + concrete ETAs before EOD Fri. Remaining items: DB migration rollback gating, metrics alert tuning, canary rollback playbook, infra quota request. Reply with owner + ETA (YYYY-MM-DD).

sam: I can own the DB migration rollback gating. ETA 2026-03-24. Will add runbook changes under /docs/inc-492/runbooks and include gating checklist. @marta tagging for dependencies.

marta: I'll take the infra quota request. ETA 2026-03-26. Need exact GPU counts from infra — @lee can you confirm counts and expected lead time?

lee: Confirmed: quota needed is +2 p4s in us-west1 and +1 in eu-west1. I'll open the request ticket and loop procurement. ETA 2026-03-25 for ticket, procurement may take longer.

aina: I'll handle metrics alert tuning and baseline checks. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234 — includes threshold suggestions + test plan. ETA 2026-03-23. Note: needs historical data window from metrics team.

josh: We still need a canary rollback playbook that lists exact commands and fast rollback criteria. I can help test but can't author whole doc this sprint.

sam: @josh I will draft the playbook (runbook + rollback commands). Can you pair on testing in staging Thu morning?

josh: Thu 09:30 PT works for me. I'll reserve time and create the canary test job.

deploy-bot: Deployed draft postmortem to docs: inc-492-postmortem-draft.md (sha: a1b2c3).

nora: Thanks — I've added an action table in the doc with the above owners. Small requests: 1) update the doc when you have a PR/ticket link, 2) if any ETA slips, edit the ETA inline and ping me.

marta: Heads-up: metrics tuning depends on @aina's PR merging and on the historical window from Product Analytics. If that data isn't available, ETA may slip.

aina: noted — pinged analytics for the 30-day window. If they can't provide, I'll use a 14-day window and mark as provisional.

sam: Quick command for folks testing canary status:
```
kubectl get pods -l canary=inc492 -n prod -o wide
```
Use that to verify healthy canary pod counts before a rollback.

josh: also add this check to the playbook: ensure no KV cache eviction spikes in the last 5m. I can script a prometheus query.

nora: Perfect. I'll run a sync on Monday and a quick check-in after the Thu test. Appreciate the quick replies. :white_check_mark:

sam: marking my action as claimed in the doc.

lee: ticket created: INFRA-7890 (quota request). Added ETA and notes.

marta: added procurement contact to the ticket.

aina: PR opened for alerts, requesting review from @marta and @sam.

nora: leaving this thread open for any quick updates; will close once all actions are green. If anything blocks, escalate here so we don't lose cross-team visibility. :eyes:
